name: rails-hyperdrive
description: MCP add-on: live introspection of a running Rails app through Rails Hyperdrive (run_ruby, run_sql, tail_logs, list_models, list_routes, locate_source, lookup_doc, describe_app). Requires the app to have rails-hyperdrive installed (bundle add rails-hyperdrive --group=development && bin/rails hyperdrive:init) and a server on port 3000. Launch it alongside another profile: claude-profile rails-developer rails-hyperdrive
